articles.title: Why Do Farts Smell So Bad? The Secret Is Brewing in Your Gut
articles.summary: Tiny gut microbes make mostly odorless gas -- but sulfur compounds, shaped by what you eat, deliver the stink.

articles.title: A 3-Million-Year-Old Child Shakes Up the Human Family Tree
articles.summary: A new study dates the Taung Child to about 3 million years ago and suggests early human relatives were far more diverse than scientists thought.

articles.title: A New Flying Drone Uses Touch to Perch Like a Bird
articles.summary: With three finger-like grippers and touch sensors, this drone can grab a branch and hang there without using extra energy.
